summary: RELX PLC filed a Form 6-K on 23 July 2026 reporting its interim results for the six months to 30 June 2026. The filing discloses strong underlying revenue growth of +7% to £4,871m, adjusted operating profit growth of +9% to £1,727m, and adjusted EPS constant-currency growth of +11% to 68.6p. It reaffirms the full-year outlook. The filing mentions two small acquisitions completed for total consideration of £103m, one small disposal, and a £550m share buyback within a previously announced £2,250m programme. These are routine operational updates, not a special situation event.
